brief_summary: Copper Finch shows declining feature adoption and active users despite rising session frequency and high seat utilisation, with an open medium-severity workflow support case indicating friction. Consent allows email outreach for recovery and personalisation.

observations.claim: Feature adoption decreased from 41.04% to 29.08% over the previous 30 days.
Active users decreased from 141 to 120 over the previous 30 days.
Session frequency increased from 3.77 to 4.85 sessions per user over the previous 30 days.
Seat utilisation is 75.95% with no prior comparison available.
One open medium-severity workflow support case exists with negative sentiment (-0.267), unresolved as of 2026-07-27.
One resolved medium-severity workflow support case exists with positive sentiment (0.465), resolved on 2026-07-20.
Billing shows two paid events: invoice issued 2026-07-08 (€5,614.80) and payment succeeded 2026-07-11 (€14,461.25), both in EUR.
Preference profile permits product email, recovery outreach, and usage personalisation via email under consent lawful basis.

hypotheses.statement: Declining feature adoption and active users may indicate emerging workflow friction despite increased session frequency.
hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence_needed: Qualitative feedback from users on feature usability or workflow-specific adoption metrics to confirm if friction is causing disengagement.

hypotheses.statement: High seat utilisation (75.95%) with declining active users suggests potential underuse by power users or uneven distribution of engagement.
hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence_needed: User-level activity logs or engagement segmentation to distinguish between broad disengagement and concentration of use.

unknowns: Root cause of declining feature adoption and active users
Whether session users are the same as active users
Specific workflow pain points from the open support case

designer_handoff.design_challenge: Create a consent-safe email-based intervention to re-engage users with underutilised features and address potential workflow friction, without requiring diagnosis of the exact cause.
priority_outcomes: Resolve or improve sentiment in open workflow support case
non_negotiables: Use only email channel for outreach
Leverage usage personalisation allowed by preference profile
Do not infer protected traits or vulnerability
Do not require knowledge of the exact workflow cause to act
success_signals: Month-over-month increase in feature adoption metric
Month-over-month increase in active users count
Resolution or sentiment improvement in open workflow support case
